title: Support / conformance report (zic-rs-support-report-v4)
description: Compile-coverage report over a source file with a bounded conformance_status rollup, declared_scope_hash, oracle_mode, and guard-enforced negative_capabilities. Published contract scope: this pins the schema **identity** (the `schema` const) and the top-level object shape. Field-level tightening and full instance-validation against a JSON-Schema validator are a tracked audit-suite item (the core crate carries no validator dependency); see docs/schema-compatibility-policy.md for the versioning rules and tests/schemas.rs for the registry/drift guard.

schema.description: the immutable schema identity; bumped only on a meaning change
